behaviors.assignee-options-counts: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with their task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing in Find a person narrows the assignee options.
behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting a person shows only their tasks and updates the task summary, while respecting the selected status.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows tasks with no assignee.
behaviors.empty-assignee-state: Selecting Ana Lima from the seed data shows “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” and a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters restores All statuses and Anyone, showing the full task board again.
